info.name: Returns all subscribed services for a given subscription id

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the root compartment.

params.name: orderLineId
params.description: Order line identifier at subscribed service level. This identifier originates from the order management module. Default is null.

params.name: status
params.description: This parameter filters subscribed services based on its status.

params.name: limit
params.description:
The maximum number of items to return in a paginated "List" call. Default: (`50`)

Example: '500'

params.name: page
params.description: The value of the 'opc-next-page' response header from the previous "List" call.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either ascending ('ASC') or descending ('DESC').

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. You can provide one sort order ('sortOrder').

items.docs: Returns all subscribed services for a given Subscription ID.

info.name: Returns the subscribed service details corresponding to the subscribed service id provided

params.name: fields
params.description:
Partial response refers to an optimization technique offered
by the RESTful web APIs, to return only the information 
(fields) required by the client. In this mechanism, the client
sends the required field names as the query parameters for
an API to the server, and the server trims down the default
response content by removing the fields that are not required
by the client. The parameter used to control which fields to
return should be a query string parameter called "fields", of
an array type, and use collectionFormat.

items.docs: Returns the subscribed service details corresponding to the provided ID.
